description: A feature flag in the ad service's `GetAds` handler threw `StatusRuntimeException(Status.UNAVAILABLE)` on ~10% of calls (`random.nextInt(10) == 0`); the frontend `/api/data` route caught the gRPC error and returned HTTP 500, but React Query's default `adList = []` fallback masked the failure in the UI — the yellow ad banner silently rendered blank rather than showing an error.
mechanism:
The flag is read in [`AdService.java#L205`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/ad/src/main/java/oteldemo/AdService.java#L205): on every `getAds` gRPC call, after ads have been collected and the request/response type attributes set, the service evaluates `ffClient.getBooleanValue("adFailure", false, evaluationContext)`. When `true`, it throws `StatusRuntimeException(Status.UNAVAILABLE)` with probability 1/10 (`random.nextInt(10) == 0`) at [`AdService.java#L206`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/ad/src/main/java/oteldemo/AdService.java#L206).

The exception is caught at [`AdService.java#L218`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/ad/src/main/java/oteldemo/AdService.java#L218): the catch block adds an "Error" span event (line 219-220), sets the span status to ERROR (line 221), logs a WARN "GetAds Failed with status {UNAVAILABLE}" (line 222), and calls `responseObserver.onError(e)` (line 223) which sends the gRPC UNAVAILABLE status back to the caller.

The frontend calls the ad service via [`Ad.gateway.ts#L14`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/frontend/gateways/rpc/Ad.gateway.ts#L14) (`client.getAds`), invoked from the `/api/data` route at [`data.ts#L15`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/frontend/pages/api/data.ts#L15). When the gRPC call fails, the error propagates through the Next.js API route as an unhandled rejection, and the frontend-proxy Envoy returns HTTP 500 to the client.

logs.name: GET /api/data → 500
logs.description: Between 15:09:27 and 15:16:14 UTC, GET /api/data?contextKeys={category} returned 500 errors three times (3 failures out of 25 completed /api/data requests after the incident, ~12%, matching the 1/10 probabilistic failure rate). Each failing request shares its traceId with an ad-service GetAds UNAVAILABLE WARN logged ~10-50 ms later. The three failing requests sample different categories (travel, books, telescopes).
logs.cause: Direct effect of the adFailure flag. pages/api/data.ts calls AdGateway.listAds, which invokes the ad service's GetAds gRPC. When adFailure is on, AdService.java:205 throws StatusRuntimeException(Status.UNAVAILABLE) with 1/10 probability (random.nextInt(10) == 0), which propagates back through the frontend gateway as a 500.

logs.name: ad: GetAds Failed (WARN)
logs.description: Between 15:09:27 and 15:16:14 UTC, the ad service emitted 3 WARN logs reporting that GetAds failed with gRPC status UNAVAILABLE. Each WARN arrives ~10-50 ms after its corresponding /api/data 500 in the frontend-proxy access log, giving a 1:1 correspondence with the GetAds UNAVAILABLE Cascade traces (matching the 3 failing traces under that cluster).
logs.cause: Smoking-gun direct evidence of the adFailure flag. Each time AdService.java:205 throws StatusRuntimeException(Status.UNAVAILABLE), execution enters the catch block at AdService.java:218, which calls logger.log(Level.WARN, "GetAds Failed with status {}", e.getStatus()) at AdService.java:222 before rethrowing to the gRPC client. The ad service explicitly names the failing RPC and echoes the UNAVAILABLE status code from the feature-flag code path.
logs.source: ad service (Java, oteldemo.AdService logger via OpenTelemetry Java agent)

frontend.description: The yellow ad banner at the bottom of product detail and checkout confirmation pages renders as a blank yellow box with no ad text and no link. The rest of the page loads normally — the failure is silent degradation, not a visible error.
frontend.trigger_condition: User visits a product detail page or checkout confirmation page, triggering an ad fetch via AdProvider. The ad service fails with 10% probability (`random.nextInt(10) == 0` in [`AdService.java#L205`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/ad/src/main/java/oteldemo/AdService.java#L205)).
frontend.call_pattern: Single direct call: AdProvider.useQuery ([`Ad.provider.tsx#L30`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/frontend/providers/Ad.provider.tsx#L30)) → ApiGateway.listAds ([`Api.gateway.ts#L103`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/frontend/gateways/Api.gateway.ts#L103)) → [`data.ts#L15`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/frontend/pages/api/data.ts#L15) → AdGateway.listAds → gRPC client.getAds ([`Ad.gateway.ts#L14`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/frontend/gateways/rpc/Ad.gateway.ts#L14)).
frontend.cause: The [`data.ts#L15`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/frontend/pages/api/data.ts#L15) API route calls `AdGateway.listAds` with no try-catch. When adFailure is on and the 1/10 random gate fires, the ad service throws `StatusRuntimeException(Status.UNAVAILABLE)` at [`AdService.java#L206`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/ad/src/main/java/oteldemo/AdService.java#L206). The gRPC error rejects the promise in [`Ad.gateway.ts#L14`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/frontend/gateways/rpc/Ad.gateway.ts#L14), propagates to [`InstrumentationMiddleware.ts#L23`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/frontend/utils/telemetry/InstrumentationMiddleware.ts#L23) which records the exception on the span and re-throws, and Next.js returns HTTP 500. On the client side, React Query in [`Ad.provider.tsx#L30`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/frontend/providers/Ad.provider.tsx#L30) catches the failure and defaults `adList` to `[]`. The Ad component ([`Ad.tsx#L10`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/frontend/components/Ad/Ad.tsx#L10)) falls back to `{ text: '', redirectUrl: '' }`, rendering the styled yellow banner with empty content.

traces.name: GetAds UNAVAILABLE Cascade
traces.description: Between 15:09:27 and 15:16:14 UTC, 3 traces show ad:oteldemo.AdService/GetAds failing with gRPC status 14 UNAVAILABLE and cascading through the frontend /api/data path. All 3 traces have root operation load-generator:user_get_ads. The 3 failures span ~7 minutes, consistent with the load generator's user_get_ads cadence multiplied by the ~1/10 probabilistic failure rate.
traces.cause: Direct effect of the adFailure flag. When adFailure is on, AdService.java:205 throws StatusRuntimeException(Status.UNAVAILABLE) with 1/10 probability (random.nextInt(10) == 0). The exception is caught at AdService.java:218, logged as WARN at line 222, then surfaced to the gRPC client via responseObserver.onError(...). The error propagates through frontend's AdGateway to the Next.js /api/data route handler, which returns HTTP 500, and finally back out through the frontend-proxy Envoy to the load generator.
traces.call_chain: ad:oteldemo.AdService/GetAds → frontend:oteldemo.AdService/GetAds → frontend:executing api route (pages) /api/data → frontend:GET /api/data → frontend-proxy:router frontend egress → frontend-proxy:GET → load-generator:GET
smoking_gun: ad:oteldemo.AdService/GetAds span: otel.status_code=ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code=14, rpc.service=oteldemo.AdService, rpc.method=GetAds, and log event {event: "Error", exception.message: "UNAVAILABLE"} — no description, no stacktrace, matching the bare `throw new StatusRuntimeException(Status.UNAVAILABLE)` at AdService.java:206

ad:oteldemo.AdService/GetAds span attributes app.ads.count=1-2 and app.ads.ad_request_type=TARGETED with app.ads.contextKeys=[telescopes], [books], or [travel], set at AdService.java:195 before the flag check at line 205 — proves execution reached the flag-triggered throw with ads already prepared (rules out upstream failures in getAdsByCategory/getRandomAds)
ad:getAdsByCategory child span completes successfully with no errors — the failure is injected by the explicit flag-triggered throw in getAds, not by any downstream dependency

frontend:oteldemo.AdService/GetAds client span carries the received gRPC error as tag grpc.error_message="14 UNAVAILABLE: " with rpc.grpc.status_code=14 (trailing colon with empty description, characteristic of the Java server not calling .withDescription(...))
